'''Vekanda Leisure Colonies''' was a company.

==History==
Vekanda purchased the rights to colonize the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]] from the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], then constructed a resort colony on the world. However, the company experienced financial problems shortly after the colony began operating, forcing the company out of business.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
